title: Data Engineer Intern
bullets: Migrated Customer Hierarchy and Customer Master transformations from 2 Oracle packages and 1 function to Spark micro-batch pipelines, processing hundreds of thousands to multi-million-row source tables through point-in-time Iceberg tables and 4-5 self-joins, with output validation against the existing Oracle implementation and reducing the storage footprint by 10x.

Optimized storage of an on-premises Apache Iceberg data lake from 140 TB to 70 TB by automating daily snapshot expiration and orphan-file cleanup across Bronze/Silver/Gold tables, with targeted metadata cleanup for critical tables to keep storage growth sustainable.

Automated detection of stalled Spark workloads across 200+ tables by building a Kafka-driven PySpark monitoring pipeline that aggregated 30-minute activity into 2-hour and 1-day windows, applied per-table staleness thresholds, and triggered Webex alerts through an API.
Restored 5-6 failing production jobs by tracing type-casting regressions through shared pipeline logic, creating a versioned compatible implementation, and updating 3-4 dependent integration points.
